title: Ciammotta – Summer Vegetable Stew Recipe
ldInstructionsRaw: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan, then add the onion, garlic and chilli flakes. Sweat on a medium heat until the onions are translucent and keep stirring to prevent the garlic from burning
Add the chopped vegetables along with the tinned tomatoes and leave to simmer for 1 hour. If the liquid reduces too much, top up with a little stock or water
Taste and season with salt and pepper
Fold through plenty of torn basil and serve immediately or at room temperature
